title: The fake-install-root fixture has six homes and converging two of them would read as done
body:
**Six test files build a fake install root; two extracted a helper and did it differently, four build it inline.** Measured by ic 2026-09-08 on vc's order to bring the number before any patch. `intent-cli/tests/{an_absent_rule_library_is_visible_at_the_process_surface,bootstrap_door,claude_cwi_door,exit_code_consumers}.rs` and `intentsvcs/tests/{skills_sync,subagents_payload}.rs`.

The two extracted shapes are not rivals: `fixture_install(dir: &Path) -> PathBuf` has the caller own the tempdir; `fixture_install() -> TempDir` creates it and additionally seeds `intent/plugins/claude/bin` with a copied launcher. **C is A plus a plugin step.** The honest convergence is a base that builds marker + copied binary and returns the dir, with plugin seeding as a separate call.

**THE CONDITION ON DOING IT, AND IT IS THE WHOLE REASON THIS IS FILED RATHER THAN DONE: ALL SIX OR NONE.** Converging the extracted pair while four sites keep building it inline takes the count from six to five and **makes the finding read as done**, which removes the pressure to finish it. ic's phrasing: *that is the cosmetic half of the job*. A partial convergence is worse than none, because none stays visible.

**NOT A MEMBER, AND IT WAS ON THE LIST FOR TWO DAYS:** `intent-cli/tests/critic_surface.rs` builds no fake install at all. It uses `repo_root()`, a `fixture(name)` pointing at the REAL shipped rule library, and drives `CARGO_BIN_EXE_intent` from the repo root -- **its subject IS the real tree, deliberately.** It was carried on the strength of having a function called `fixture`. **Classified by the name of a function rather than by what the function does**, which is the third instance this week of a name asserting a behaviour nobody checked the body for.

**SEPARATE AND SHARPER, RULED AND BEING DONE NOW, NOT PART OF THIS ISSUE:** three files re-implement `fn repo_root()` as `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/../../../..` while 36 use `testkit::repo_root`. That is a real divergence with a failure mode -- testkit asserts `schema/` and `surface/` are both directories and fails loudly by name; path arithmetic returns a directory that exists whatever it points at, so a wrong root is silent and every test then runs against it. **`testkit/src/lib.rs:70-72` already makes this argument in its own doc comment**, for the workspace root, in the canonical home the three copies bypass.
